title: The cheapest route
intro: Seven towns are joined by roads, each with its toll. Travel from {from} to {to} as cheaply as you can: choose one road at a time, then check your route against the cheapest one, which the app finds with Dijkstra's algorithm.
at: You are in {town}. Your route so far: {route} (toll {cost}).
arrived: You have reached the goal. Your route costs {cost}.
right: Right: {cost} is the cheapest toll there is.
more: Your route costs {cost}; the cheapest costs {best}: {path}.
engineError: The route finder is not available here ({code}).
mapLabel: Map of seven towns and their roads. Your route: {route}, toll {cost}.
